⚙️ Notifications & app notes

This HTML app can request browser notification permission, but local files may not be allowed to send notifications. Timed reminders only run while this page is open and active; they are not guaranteed after closing the tab or when Android suspends Chrome.

For reliable daily alerts: use Android Clock → Alarm → set 6:30 AM, 7:00 AM, 3:40 PM, 4:00 PM and 10:15 PM → Repeat every day. For browser notifications when closed, this app must be hosted and configured as an installable web app; a local HTML file alone cannot guarantee background notifications.
